message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_15941",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_fast_extState",
    "line":1161,"var":"maxOutputSize","code":"return LZ4_compress_generic(ctx, source, dest, inputSize, NULL, maxOutputSize, limitedOutput, tableType, noDict, noDictIssue, acceleration);",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"maxOutputSize (791) is passed as the output buffer limit for compression with limitedOutput directive"},
   {"step":2,"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_generic",
    "line":813,"var":"olimit","code":"BYTE* const olimit = op + maxOutputSize;",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"olimit is set to dest + 791, marking the output buffer boundary"},
   {"step":3,"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_generic",
    "line":1010,"var":"matchCode","code":"matchCode = LZ4_count(ip+MINMATCH, match+MINMATCH, matchlimit);",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"matchCode computed as 199990 due to highly repetitive input (all zeros), representing a very long match"},
   {"step":4,"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_generic",
    "line":1016,"var":"matchCode>>8","code":"(unlikely(op + (1 + LASTLITERALS) + (matchCode>>8) > olimit))",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Overflow check uses matchCode>>8 (division by 256) instead of matchCode/255 to estimate output bytes needed. For matchCode=199990, this underestimates by 3 bytes, allowing the check to pass when the buffer is actually too small"},
   {"step":5,"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_generic",
    "line":1033,"var":"op","code":"LZ4_write32(op, 0xFFFFFFFF);",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"4-byte write in match length encoding loop overflows the 791-byte output buffer at byte 791 (0 bytes past the end)"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_fast_extState",
     "line":1161,"operands":["maxOutputSize"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_generic",
     "line":1016,"operands":["op + (1 + LASTLITERALS) + (matchCode>>8)","olimit"],
     "relation":{"op":"gt","left":"op + (1 + LASTLITERALS) + (matchCode/255)","right":"olimit"}},
   "sink":{"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_generic",
     "line":1033,"operands":["op","olimit"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"op + 4","right":"olimit"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_fast_extState",
       "line":1161,"operands":["maxOutputSize"]},
      "to":{"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_generic",
       "line":813,"operands":["olimit"]},
      "type":"data","via":["maxOutputSize"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"olimit","right":"op + maxOutputSize"}},
     {"from":{"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_generic",
       "line":1016,"operands":["matchCode>>8"]},
      "to":{"file":"lib/lz4.c","function":"LZ4_compress_generic",
       "line":1033,"operands":["op"]},
      "type":"control","via":["matchCode>>8"],
      "relation":{"op":"le","left":"op + (1 + LASTLITERALS) + (matchCode>>8)","right":"olimit"}}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
